tweet.text: We were glad to help @magicailabs develop their AGI Readiness Policy. We believe when AI developers publish publicly legible thresholds at which they believe they would currently be unprepared to safely develop their models, it's a valuable step towards making safety concrete.

quote.text: Our AGI Readiness Policy (http://magic.dev/agi-readiness-policy) was developed in collaboration with @METR_Evals and we've started work on v2, focusing on safety testing models capable of adaptive inference-time compute utilization.
